description: One agent's registry events (mint, transfers, profile link updates) and the public history of claims on it, each with its date. Needs an API key: set NOOSCAPE_API_KEY (a free key is enough).

chain.description: The chain: robinhood, bnb, solana, ethereum, base, arc or monad.

id.description: The agent's id on its registry: the token id (digits) on robinhood, bnb, ethereum, base, arc and monad, the address on solana.

registry.description: Solana only, when more than one registry lists the address (the answer then names them).

name: get_agent_history
title: Get one agent's history
